stories.title: Game 1 Recap — Three Cubs Go Deep in D.C., Chicago Reaches 70 Wins
stories.angle: PCA (HR No. 27), Bregman (No. 13), and Suzuki (No. 20) all homered as the Cubs took Game 1 in Washington. Imanaga left in the 5th inning with a 6-4 lead after allowing three home runs; Rolison (7-1) bridged the gap. Cubs improve to 70-50 — 20 games over .500 for the first time this season. Lead with the three-homer night, NOT the game score per has_score=False insight.

stories.title: Cubs 70-50 — Season-Best 20 Games Over .500
stories.angle: Chicago was 34-34 on June 10. Since then: 36-16. That's the best 50-game stretch this organization has produced in years. They're now 20 games over .500 for the first time all season. This isn't a hot streak — it's a level change.

stories.title: Game Preview — Peterson vs Mikolas, Nationals Bullpen Is the Vulnerability

The Cubs' lineup is too deep for Washington's relief corps to handle.
